Class EventStreamState

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.sse.EventStreamState
public final class EventStreamState extends Object
The reconnection state of an event stream: the last event id and the reconnection time, as the event stream interpretation keeps them. Unlike the events, the state also follows an id or a retry field of a block without data, which dispatches no event.

To follow the state of the stream of SseClient.eventStream(io.micronaut.http.HttpRequest, io.micronaut.core.type.Argument), set an instance as the ATTRIBUTE attribute of the request. The state is updated as the stream is read, before the event of the same block is emitted, and can be read from any thread. A state may be reused across the connections of one event source.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
